cves.description: Cisco IOS XE Web UI privilege escalation — allows remote attacker to create admin account
cves.remediation: Disable HTTP/HTTPS server: no ip http server / no ip http secure-server

cves.description: Cisco IOS/IOS XE Group Encrypted Transport VPN out-of-bounds write
cves.remediation: Upgrade to patched version; disable GET VPN if not in use

cves.description: Cisco IOS XE fragmented tunnel protocol packet DoS
cves.remediation: Upgrade IOS XE to fixed release

cves.description: Cisco IOS/IOS XE SSH DoS vulnerability
cves.remediation: Upgrade to IOS 15.9(3)M7 or later

cves.description: Cisco IOS XE Web UI command injection vulnerability
cves.remediation: Disable web UI or upgrade to patched release

cves.description: Cisco IOS XE SD-WAN remote code execution via vManage
cves.remediation: Upgrade to IOS XE 17.5.1a or later

cves.description: Cisco IOS XR DVMRP memory exhaustion DoS
cves.remediation: Disable IGMP on untrusted interfaces; upgrade to patched version

cves.description: ClamAV HFS+ file system image parsing heap buffer overflow (affects IOS with UTD)
cves.remediation: Upgrade ClamAV / IOS XE UTD engine

cves.description: Apache HTTP Server SSRF via mod_proxy (affects Cisco IOS XE webui)
cves.remediation: Disable HTTP server; upgrade IOS XE

cves.description: Cisco Small Business RV Series routers authentication bypass
cves.remediation: No fix available — EOL product. Replace hardware.

cves.description: Huawei VRP stack buffer overflow in web management interface
cves.remediation: Upgrade VRP to V200R009C00SPC500 or later; disable HTTP access

cves.description: Huawei VRP SNMP remote code execution
cves.remediation: Disable SNMPv1/v2c; upgrade to patched VRP version

cves.description: Huawei VRP kernel privilege escalation in netfilter
cves.remediation: Apply Huawei security patch HWPSIRT-2021-56312

cves.description: Juniper Junos J-Web PHP environment variable manipulation RCE
cves.remediation: Disable J-Web or restrict access to trusted hosts; upgrade Junos OS

cves.description: Juniper Junos J-Web PHP external variable modification
cves.remediation: Disable J-Web; upgrade Junos OS

cves.description: Juniper Junos SRX Series file upload without authentication via J-Web
cves.remediation: Disable J-Web; apply Junos security update

cves.description: Juniper Junos J-Web phar deserialization RCE
cves.remediation: Upgrade Junos OS to fixed release; disable J-Web

cves.description: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset DDoS vulnerability (affects multiple vendors)
cves.remediation: Apply vendor-specific patches; enable HTTP/2 rate limiting

cves.description: Log4Shell — affects network management platforms (vManage, NSO, etc.)
cves.remediation: Patch management platform; upgrade Log4j to 2.17.1+

cves.description: OpenSSL X.509 certificate name constraint check confusion (embedded in many network OS)
cves.remediation: Upgrade to firmware bundling OpenSSL 3.0.8+ or 1.1.1t+
